name: Compass
subtitle: The Behavioral Interview Atlas
heroH1:
Tell stories
that land & show
scope that scales.
heroLede: Treat the behavioral round like the engineering problem it is \u2014 name the signal behind the question, pick the story that proves it, and land it so the interviewer can score you. Then build a reusable story bank that covers every signal area you will be asked about.
featLabs: Grade a story against the signal rubric, drill the story shortlist on a live prompt, run a SALT timer, map your catalog onto a coverage matrix, and spot the missing "I" in a transcript.
pathBanner: Pick Course Foundations, Delivery Craft, Story Bank, or Company Playbooks and copy the path as Markdown study notes.

paths.title: Course Foundations
paths.label: Foundations
paths.desc: Why the round exists, the eight signal areas behind it, and how to name the signal and pick the story before you say a word.

paths.title: Delivery Craft
paths.label: Delivery
paths.desc: SALT, the three questions you will always be asked, and the pitfalls that quietly cost the offer.

paths.title: Advanced Rounds
paths.label: Advanced
paths.desc: Special interview types, the new questions about working with AI, and how to actually practise.

paths.title: Story Bank
paths.label: Stories
paths.desc: Engineer a catalog bottom-up, prove scope, and map every story onto the signals interviewers score.

paths.title: Company Playbooks
paths.label: Playbooks
paths.desc: Adapt the same catalog to big-tech loops, principle-based rubrics, startups, and the manager track.
